svg.title: Raspberry Pi 5 header pins used by the cane
svg.desc: All 40 header pins. The cane uses pin 12 for driver R_EN, 16 for RPWM, 17 for VCC, 18 for LPWM, 20 for GND, 22 for L_EN, 29, 31 and 33 for the left, right and centre limit switches, and 39 as the switches' ground. Pins 2 and 4 are 5 volts.
